title: Senior Backend Engineer (TypeScript)
description:
Northwind Systems builds observability tooling for distributed systems. We are looking for a senior backend engineer to own our ingestion pipeline, which processes several billion events per day.

You will work in TypeScript on Node.js services backed by PostgreSQL and ClickHouse, deployed to Kubernetes. The team is fully remote across European time zones.
requirements: 5+ years building backend services in production
Strong SQL and relational data modelling
responsibilities: Own the design and reliability of the event ingestion pipeline
Improve query performance across the analytics tier
Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation

title: Senior Backend Engineer, TypeScript (Remote)
description: Senior backend engineer wanted at Northwind Systems to own a high-throughput event ingestion pipeline built in TypeScript on Node.js, PostgreSQL and ClickHouse, running on Kubernetes. Fully remote across Europe.
responsibilities: Own event ingestion
Improve analytics query performance

title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform
description:
Halcyon Data is hiring a staff engineer to lead our internal developer platform. You will define the golden path for roughly forty engineers: build tooling, CI/CD, environment provisioning and service templates.

This role is based in our Berlin office with two days per week on site. We sponsor work visas for candidates relocating to Germany.
requirements: Proven ownership of developer platform or infrastructure work
responsibilities: Define and evolve the internal developer platform
Own CI/CD tooling and build performance
Partner with product teams on adoption

title: Full-Stack Engineer (React / Node)
description:
Bright Orbit builds scheduling software for field service teams. We are a twelve-person, fully distributed company. You will work across a Next.js frontend and a Node.js backend with PostgreSQL and Prisma.

We value engineers who can take a vague problem, talk to customers, and ship a working solution.
requirements: Comfortable owning features end to end
responsibilities: Ship customer-facing features across the stack
Talk directly to customers about their workflows
Keep the codebase maintainable as the team grows

title: Senior Software Engineer, Payments
description:
Vantage Payments processes card and account-to-account payments for European merchants. We need a senior engineer for the core payments team, working on authorisation, settlement and reconciliation.

This is a hybrid role, three days per week in our London office. We are unable to sponsor visas for this position.
requirements: 5+ years backend engineering in a regulated environment
Strong understanding of transactional correctness and idempotency
Right to work in the UK — we cannot sponsor
responsibilities: Build and operate payment authorisation services
Own reconciliation correctness
Support incident response for payment flows

title: Senior Engineer, Developer Experience
description:
Ferrous AI builds inference infrastructure. We are hiring a senior engineer for developer experience: our SDKs, CLI, documentation tooling and example applications.

You will write TypeScript and Python, and you will care a lot about the first fifteen minutes a developer spends with a product.
requirements: Have built and maintained a public SDK or CLI
responsibilities: Own the TypeScript and Python SDKs
Improve onboarding and documentation tooling
Represent developer feedback to the platform team

title: Senior Engineer — Developer Experience (Remote)
description: Ferrous AI is hiring a senior developer experience engineer to own our TypeScript and Python SDKs, CLI and documentation tooling. Remote across US and EU time zones.
responsibilities: Own SDKs
Improve developer onboarding

title: WordPress Developer
description: Cedar & Bloom is a boutique agency building marketing sites for lifestyle brands. We need a WordPress developer to build and maintain custom themes and plugins in PHP.
responsibilities: Build custom WordPress themes
Maintain client plugins

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description: A well-compensated senior full-stack role working in TypeScript, React and Node.js on a large consumer product. This posting exists in the fixture to exercise the excludedCompanies filter — the company name matches the exclusion list in the placeholder profile.
responsibilities: Ship consumer-facing features
Own service reliability

title: Backend Engineer (Python)
description:
Meridian Health builds clinical data infrastructure for European hospital groups. We are hiring a backend engineer to work on our FHIR ingestion services in Python.

Hybrid, two days per week in Amsterdam. Visa sponsorship and relocation support available.
responsibilities: Build and maintain FHIR ingestion pipelines
Work with clinical partners on data quality
Own service monitoring for your components

title: Software Engineer II
description: Kestrel Logistics builds freight-forwarding software. We are hiring a mid-level engineer for our Yerevan office to work on our TypeScript backend and internal tooling.
requirements: Willingness to work from our Yerevan office
responsibilities: Build features on the shipment tracking backend
Maintain internal operations tooling

title: Principal Engineer, Commerce Platform
description:
Atlas Retail Group operates commerce platforms for several European retail brands. We are hiring a principal engineer to set technical direction across five product teams.

This is a hands-on architecture role: you will write code, but your primary output is technical strategy and the decisions that unblock other teams.
requirements: Track record setting technical direction across multiple teams
responsibilities: Set architectural direction for the commerce platform
Lead design reviews across five teams
Drive the migration away from the legacy monolith

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
Lumen Docs builds a collaborative document editor. We are looking for a contract frontend engineer for a six-month engagement to help ship our new editing surface in React.

No salary range is published for this posting — rate is negotiated per engagement.
responsibilities: Ship the new editing surface
Improve rendering performance for large documents

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: Sentinel Security provides managed detection and response. We are hiring a senior platform engineer to own our Terraform estate, Kubernetes clusters and CI/CD tooling across three cloud providers.
requirements: 5+ years in platform or infrastructure engineering
responsibilities: Own infrastructure as code across three clouds
Improve deployment safety and rollback
Reduce cloud spend without reducing reliability

responsibilities: Own the ingestion and transformation layers
Improve query latency for large customer datasets
Design schema evolution for multi-tenant data

requirements: Native module experience on iOS or Android
responsibilities: Ship features across iOS and Android
Own release engineering for mobile builds

title: Software Engineering Intern
description: Oakford Consulting is offering a six-month engineering internship in Berlin. You will work alongside a senior engineer on internal tooling in TypeScript.
requirements: Currently enrolled in a degree programme
responsibilities: Contribute to internal tooling
Pair with senior engineers

title: Senior Engineer, Low Latency
description: Beacon Trading Systems builds execution infrastructure for proprietary trading firms. We are hiring a senior engineer for our low-latency execution path, written primarily in C++ with Rust components.
requirements: Modern C++ or Rust in production
Experience with latency profiling and optimisation
responsibilities: Optimise the order execution hot path
Own latency benchmarking infrastructure

title: Engineering Manager, Backend
description: Willowbrook Systems is hiring an engineering manager for two backend teams (eleven engineers total). This is a people-leadership role: hiring, growth, delivery and technical direction. Expect roughly 20% hands-on coding.
responsibilities: Lead two backend teams
Own hiring and performance growth
Partner with product on roadmap

title: Full Stack Engineer (React/Node)
description: Bright Orbit, a twelve-person distributed team building field service scheduling software, is hiring a full-stack engineer for its Next.js and Node.js stack with PostgreSQL and Prisma.
responsibilities: Ship customer-facing features
Own features end to end

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Helio Analytics builds forecasting products for energy traders. We are hiring an ML engineer to own model development end to end: feature engineering, training, evaluation and the pipelines that keep them fed.

The stack is Python throughout, with pandas and scikit-learn for modelling and PostgreSQL behind the feature store.
requirements: 3+ years building and evaluating machine learning models in production
Solid grounding in statistics and model evaluation
Comfortable writing SQL against large tables
responsibilities: Own feature engineering and model evaluation for the forecasting suite
Build and maintain training and inference pipelines
Communicate model behaviour to non-technical stakeholders

title: Quantitative Researcher (Market Data)
description:
Thornbury Capital is a small systematic trading group. We are looking for a quantitative researcher to work on market data pipelines, signal design and strategy backtesting.

This is research work: exploratory data analysis, hypothesis testing, and a lot of care about whether a result is real. Python, pandas and a strong statistics background matter more than any particular framework.
requirements: Demonstrated quantitative research experience, professional or independent
Rigour about overfitting and out-of-sample testing
responsibilities: Build and maintain market data pipelines
Design and test trading signals
Document research findings clearly

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description:
Verity Vision builds inspection systems for manufacturing lines. We are hiring a computer vision engineer to work on defect detection and 3D measurement from point cloud data.

Our team is in Yerevan, hybrid three days a week.
requirements: Computer vision experience with OpenCV or equivalent
Exposure to point cloud or spatial data processing
responsibilities: Develop defect detection models for production inspection
Process and analyse point cloud data
Run experiments and report on trade-offs

title: Senior Data Scientist
description: Loomis Data provides analytics to European retailers. We are hiring a senior data scientist to own recommendation and demand forecasting models, working closely with the engineering team that ships them.
requirements: 5+ years in data science or applied ML
responsibilities: Own the recommendation and forecasting model portfolio
Design offline and online evaluation
Partner with engineering on productionisation

title: ML Engineer (Remote, Europe)
description: Helio Analytics is hiring a machine learning engineer for its energy forecasting products — feature engineering, model evaluation and training pipelines in Python, pandas and scikit-learn over PostgreSQL.
responsibilities: Own feature engineering and evaluation
Maintain training pipelines

title: Research Engineer, Deep Learning
description: Cobalt Robotics Systems is hiring a research engineer for perception. You will train and deploy deep learning models on large-scale sensor data, working primarily in PyTorch on multi-GPU infrastructure.
requirements: PhD or equivalent research experience in deep learning
Published work in perception or robotics
responsibilities: Train perception models on large sensor datasets
Own the research-to-production path

title: Data Engineer
description: Aster Health Data builds the data platform behind clinical analytics products. We are hiring a data engineer to own ingestion, transformation and data quality across a Postgres and Airflow stack.
responsibilities: Own ingestion and transformation pipelines
